description: Level 1 Quick Features: Music Library, Expanded Templates (15 total), Dark/Light Mode Toggle, Onboarding Tutorial, and Social Share Buttons
steps: 1. MUSIC LIBRARY - Create src/app/dashboard/music/page.tsx with a royalty-free music library page. Include 15-20 sample tracks organized by mood/genre (Energetico, Chill, Motivacional, Cinematic, Lo-Fi, Pop). Each track should have: name, artist, duration, BPM, mood tag, and a play/pause preview button (use HTML5 Audio with placeholder URLs like /audio/track-name.mp3). Add a 'Seleccionar' button to pick a track. Add 'Musica' to the sidebar navigation in src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx with Music icon from lucide-react.

2. MORE TEMPLATES - Update src/app/dashboard/templates/page.tsx to have 15 templates total. Add categories: Viajes, Negocios, Tecnologia, Moda, Gaming, Mascotas beyond existing ones. Add templates: 'Destinos de Viaje' (travel), 'Pitch de Negocio' (business), 'Tech Unboxing' (tech), 'Outfit del Dia' (fashion), 'Gaming Highlights' (gaming), 'Mascotas Adorables' (pets), 'Noticias Express' (news). Each with unique gradient colors and descriptions. Also update the TemplateSelector component in src/components/video/TemplateSelector.tsx to match.

3. DARK/LIGHT MODE TOGGLE - Create src/hooks/useTheme.ts using zustand with persist middleware to store theme preference. Create a ThemeToggle component at src/components/shared/ThemeToggle.tsx with Sun/Moon icons. Update src/app/layout.tsx to use a ThemeProvider that reads the stored theme and applies/removes the 'dark' class on <html>. Add light mode color definitions to tailwind.config.ts and src/app/globals.css (light body bg: white, light text: gray-900, light card: white with gray border). Add the toggle to the dashboard layout header area and the public Navbar.

4. ONBOARDING TUTORIAL - Create src/components/shared/Onboarding.tsx as a 3-step modal overlay. Step 1: 'Crea tu primer video' (explains one-click generation). Step 2: 'Personaliza con plantillas' (shows template options). Step 3: 'Comparte en redes sociales' (shows sharing features). Use framer-motion for smooth transitions between steps. Store completion in localStorage key 'autoreel_onboarding_completed'. Show on first visit to /dashboard. Include skip button and progress dots.

5. SOCIAL SHARE BUTTONS - Create src/components/shared/ShareButtons.tsx with share buttons for WhatsApp, Twitter/X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Telegram, and Copy Link. Each button opens the respective share URL in a new window. Add these share buttons to the video export step (Step 4) in src/app/dashboard/create/page.tsx after the download button. Also add to the videos list page context menu.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes without errors
Music library page renders with 15+ tracks with play/preview capability
Templates page shows 15 templates across 10+ categories
Dark/Light mode toggle persists preference and correctly switches all UI colors
Onboarding modal shows on first dashboard visit with 3 steps and can be dismissed
Share buttons appear on video export and open correct share URLs
verification: Run npm run build and confirm zero errors
findings: All 5 sub-features implemented and build passes. Music library has 18 tracks across 6 moods. Templates expanded to 15 across 13 categories. Theme toggle uses zustand persist. Onboarding uses framer-motion AnimatePresence. ShareButtons added to Step 4 of create page. No test framework - validated via npm run build only.
